game: Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays the 100 m. Menus run at 60 fps; events run at 30 fps because the game asks for that itself (its frame interval is 2 there). Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the menus. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
